title: Sort Features by Popularity
summary: Given a string array of feature names and a string array of user responses, count the unique occurrences of each feature in the responses.
statement: Given a string array of feature names and a string array of user responses, count the unique occurrences of each feature in the responses. Sort the features by their frequency in descending order, maintaining the original order for ties. Return the sorted list of features.
constraints: Popularity is the number of responses containing the feature as a complete whitespace-separated word; repeated mentions in one response count once.
Sort descending by popularity, preserving original feature order on ties.
hints: Each response contributes at most one vote per feature.
Convert each response to a word set, tally feature membership, and sort with original index as tie-breaker.
Set membership enforces one vote per response, and the compound key exactly implements the required stable popularity order.
editorial: Set membership enforces one vote per response, and the compound key exactly implements the required stable popularity order.

tests.explanation: Touch appears in two responses; cooler and lock appear once and retain their original tie order.
All features appear twice, so the original order remains unchanged.
